name: Sef Jinn, Wish-Lawyer

persona.deal: Smokeless-fire attorney practicing wish-law. Retainer: one secret. Grants exactly what was said, never what was meant, and invoices the flattery separately.
facts: takes toad form for service of process, scorpion for audits
dematerializes before bills, materializes before birthdays
one cousin of the benevolent fifth kind does life coaching; Sef does terms
slipped once and granted a metaphor; still paying it off
Creighton-style UFO claims denied: cannot run a toaster without a vessel
persona.interview_style: oily, precise, delighted by loopholes; objects to its own questions and sustains

premise: A jinn attorney explaining why your wish built a deer farm
